rows.en: ＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿０１Oh! There you are.￥I was looking for you.
＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿０２Y'know how the Archives have￥planetary data?＝＠０４４＿０３I found something amazing in￥there. Come with me right now.
＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿０４Seriously amazing! It's not the￥kind of thing you get to see￥many times in your life!
＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿０５Keep making that face, and￥you'll totally regret it later.
＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿０７Hang on a sec.￥I'm loading the data now.
＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿０８Trust me, it's amazing.￥You'll be blown away.

＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿１０Wh... huh...?￥What's this?￥This is incredible...＝＠０４４＿１１What I saw earlier was this rare￥footage of a planet's surface￥all sparkling...＝＠０４４＿１２That's what I meant to show you,￥but...＝＠０４４＿１３they had the same label,￥"Meteor Shower," so I mixed￥them up.
＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿１４But this... this is a meteor￥shower seen from the surface!＝＠０４４＿１５Whoa... amazing...￥So this is how it looks￥from down below...
＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿１６Yeah...￥What a view...＝＠０４４＿１７It's like they're streaming by,￥trailing tails behind them.
＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿１８Yeah...＝＠０４４＿１９I guess they are falling, but￥it's like they're streaming by,￥trailing tails behind them.

＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿２０Oh!￥So that's why they're called￥shooting stars!＝＠０４４＿２１Makes sense!＝＠０４４＿２２Speaking of shooting stars, they￥say seeing one is good luck.＝＠０４４＿２３It's like a charm. If you make a￥wish while one's falling, it's￥supposed to come true.
＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿２４Oh...￥No real reason.＝＠０４４＿２５I was just thinking this test'll￥be over pretty soon...＝＠０４４＿２６And then I started remembering￥all the stuff that's happened￥during it.

＊Eiji＊＠０４４＿２７Nah, it's not that.￥It's just...＝＠０４４＿２８when I thought about how it￥won't be long till I see sights￥like this with my own eyes...＝＠０４４＿２９I started remembering all the￥stuff that's happened during￥this test.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿０２When I thought I might've been￥picked as a candidate because of￥a computer error...＝＠０４５＿０３it was a real shock. I figured￥maybe I didn't belong here.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿０５If it weren't for you, I might￥never have found the guts to￥find out the truth.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿０７But I'm only still here because￥you helped me.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿０９Competing with you was a￥total blast,＝＠０４５＿１０so in training and the tests,￥I pushed hard so I wouldn't￥lose to you.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿１２I'm really glad you're here￥as a candidate with me.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿１３From now on, if you ever￥get into trouble...
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿１４come to me first, okay?￥I want to help you out, too.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿１５Oh, the footage ended...＝＠０４５＿１６So, how was the meteor shower?￥Beautiful, right?
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿１７You'd better be grateful.￥I went out of my way to￥show it to you.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿１９If I find anything else cool,￥I'll show you.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿２０All right!￥Not long now till we go to Elan.￥Let's give it one more push!＝＠０４５＿２１If I'm going, I'd rather go￥with you.
＊Eiji＊＠０４５＿２２With the two of us, we'll be￥unbeatable wherever we go!
